title: 竹垣（建仁寺垣風）1区画
description: 住宅の生け垣脇や料亭の前に立つ、建仁寺垣風の竹垣1区画です。焼き杉の柱2本と頭部、縦に並べた竹と節の輪、表裏に渡した3段の押し縁の竹、シュロ縄の結び、上部の笠竹を造形しています。竹は割り竹の断面ではなく丸竹で単純化し、風化の汚れや連続設置用の継ぎ手は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.890 × 1.310 × 0.114 m、13,636三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: One section of a kenninji-style bamboo fence for residential frontages and traditional restaurants. It models two charred-cedar posts with caps, vertical bamboo with node rings, three tiers of horizontal bamboo rails on both faces, black palm-cord ties and a top cap bamboo. Bamboo is simplified as round culms rather than split strips; weathering stains and joints for continuous runs are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.890 × 1.310 × 0.114 m; 13,636 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
